test_item:
The ECUCert Library shall expose a standard C++ API for certificate verification to support all native clients.
(verification function returns OK for an unchanged certificate file)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. An ECU certificate chain is present on the DUT
proc:
1. Confirm the content of /data/misc/ecuidentity on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /data/misc/ecuidentity
2. <DUT-side trigger for ECU certificate chain for the DUT serial number provided by STLA (X-d)>
$ <command provided by STLA (X-d)>
3. Confirm the ECU_CERT_SERVICE_FUNCTION_ID log after the previous step
$ adb logcat -s ECU_CERT_SERVICE_FUNCTION_ID
er:
1. The adb shell ls -l /data/misc/ecuidentity output lists "ecu.cacert"
2. <observable outcome provided by STLA (X-d)>
3. The adb logcat -s ECU_CERT_SERVICE_FUNCTION_ID output contains "ECU_INSTALLATION_STATUS value : 2 -> 1"
